quack.definition:
n. an untrained person who pretends to be a physician and who dispenses medical advice
n. the harsh sound of a duck
v. utter quacking noises
quack.translation:
n. 鸭叫声, 冒牌医生, 冒充内行之人
a. 冒牌医生的
v. 嘎嘎叫, 当冒牌医生, 夸大广告

quack-quack.definition: n. child's word for a duck

quacked.definition:
v utter quacking noises
v act as a medical quack or a charlatan
quacked.translation: v. （鸭子）发出嘎嘎声( quack的过去式和过去分词 )

quacker.translation: n. 鸭子, 发出嘎嘎声的人

quackeries.translation: n. 庸医的医术, 骗子的行为( quackery的名词复数 )

quackers.definition:
plural of quacker
s medically unqualified
quackers.translation: (quacker 的复数) n.鸭子, 发出嘎嘎声的人

quackery.definition: n. medical practice and advice based on observation and experience in ignorance of scientific findings
quackery.translation:
n. 骗人的治疗, 招摇撞骗, 骗子的行为
[医] 江湖医术

quackgrass.definition: n European grass spreading rapidly by creeping rhizomes; naturalized in North America as a weed

quacking.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Quack
quacking.translation: v. （鸭子）发出嘎嘎声( quack的现在分词 )

quackings.definition:
plural of quacking
p. pr. & vb. n. of Quack
quackings.translation: (quacking 的复数) v. （鸭子）发出嘎嘎声( quack的现在分词 )

quackish.definition: a. Like a quack; boasting; characterized by quackery.
quackish.translation: a. 庸医的, 胡吹的, 骗人的

quacks.definition:
n an untrained person who pretends to be a physician and who dispenses medical advice
n the harsh sound of a duck
v utter quacking noises
v act as a medical quack or a charlatan
quacks.translation:
abbr. quacksalvers 庸医, 骗子(16世纪习惯用水银或汞治疗梅毒的人)
n. <英>江湖医生( quack的名词复数 ); 江湖郎中; （鸭子的）呱呱声
v. （鸭子）发出嘎嘎声( quack的第三人称单数 )

quacksalver.definition:
n. One who boasts of his skill in medicines and salves,
   or of the efficacy of his prescriptions; a charlatan; a quack; a
   mountebank.
quacksalver.translation:
n. 冒牌医生, 骗子
[法] 庸医, 骗子
